plugin.note: Dusk is immune to magic and ranged - melee only. Carry a rock/granite hammer to finish.

requirements: Brittle key to access the Slayer Tower roof
Rock hammer, rock thrownhammer, or granite hammer for the finishing blow
Use the Grotesque Guardians strategy source for full boss phase mechanics
mechanics: Dusk is the grounded half of the Grotesque Guardians duo.
Dusk is immune to magic and ranged, so melee is required.
Dusk has a second form at combat level 328 on the Gargoyles task page.
The Grotesque Guardians count as one task kill unless Double Trouble is unlocked.
Carry a rock or granite hammer for Gargoyle-style finishing requirements.

methods.label: Melee only
methods.summary: Fight Dusk with melee because magic and ranged do not work.
recommendedFor: Gargoyles tasks using the rooftop boss
steps: Use melee attacks against Dusk because Dusk is immune to magic and ranged.
Use the listed melee weapon progression while avoiding Dusk's special attacks.
Carry or equip a rock/granite hammer for finishing requirements.
Use Dragon claws, Crystal halberd, or Burning claws as melee special attack options where the boss strategy calls for them.
Avoid Double Trouble if trying to preserve more boss kills per task.
notes: This JSON replaces the legacy Markdown strategy while preserving the same plugin-facing strategy fields.

methods.label: Phase 2 blinding attack
methods.summary: Melee Dusk during phase two, move one tile away when his missing wing glows, and avoid standing underneath him.
recommendedFor: players learning Dusk's first active phase
steps: Attack Dusk with melee once he becomes vulnerable in phase two.
Watch for the missing wing glow that signals his blinding attack.
Move one tile away before the attack resolves to avoid knockback.
Move away from Dawn's rockfall shadows during the same phase.
Do not stand under Dusk because his trample can hit up to 40.
risks: Standing beside or under Dusk during the blinding attack causes knockback.
Rockfall shadows resolve at different speeds and can stack damage.
notes: Dusk is immune to magic and ranged in this phase.
Burn damage has no effect against Dusk.

methods.label: Phase 4 prison and finish
methods.summary: Handle empowered Dusk's prison attack, alternate protection against melee and ranged hits, and use a hammer finisher below 10 hitpoints.
recommendedFor: players preserving supplies after Dawn dies
steps: Wait until Dusk's prison attack animation completes before clicking him again.
Run through the missing fire tile if the prison leaves no normal escape path near the exit.
Use melee only; magic and ranged remain ineffective.
Stand one tile away with halberds where possible so Dusk must choose between ranged and closing distance.
Use a rock hammer, granite hammer, rock thrownhammer, or Gargoyle smasher when Dusk is under 10 hitpoints.
risks: Clicking Dusk too early during the prison attack can path the player underneath him.
His final phase uses both melee and double-hit ranged attacks.
notes: Protection prayer reduces Dusk's melee and ranged damage but does not remove all threat.
A special attack can happen as or shortly after Dusk reaches finisher range.

styleOptions.label: Melee only
styleOptions.summary: Primary Dusk setup using melee because Dusk is immune to magic and ranged.

body:
# Grotesque Guardians - Dusk

Dusk is immune to magic and ranged - melee only. Carry a rock/granite hammer to finish.
